;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]], [[November 2019 Syria bombings]]
**A [[car bomb]] kills 17 civilians and injures 20 others in an attack in [[Ras al-Ayn]], [[Al-Hasakah Governorate]], [[Syria]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-syria-security-turkey/turkey-says-car-bomb-kills-17-near-syrias-ras-al-ain-idUSKBN1Y01ZB?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**An [[Americans|American]] is identified as the victim killed in a [[Kabul]] [[grenade]] attack on a [[United Nations]] convoy. [https://www.jpost.com/Breaking-News/Pompeo-An-American-was-killed-in-attack-on-UN-vehicle-in-Kabul-609108 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
*[[Terrorism in the Netherlands]]
**Two men are arrested in the [[Netherlands]] after plans were uncovered to commit a [[jihadist]] attack with [[explosive belt]]s and [[car bomb]]s. [https://nltimes.nl/2019/11/26/dutch-forces-arrest-two-plotting-terrorist-car-bomb-attack-years-end (NL Times)]
*[[Insurgency in Jammu and Kashmir]]
**A grenade attack kills two including a [[Government of India|government]] official and wounds four others. Two [[militant]]s were also killed in another incident. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/11/india-killed-wounded-kashmir-grenade-attacks-191126140031755.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Iraqi insurgency (2017–present)]]
**Multiple bombings in [[Baghdad]] kill six people and injure 15 others. Most are motorcycle bombs. [https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2019-11-26/baghdad-bombings-kill-5-as-iraqis-protest-government (''U.S. News and World Report'')]

;Business and economy
*[[Foreign relations of Israel]]
**It is announced that in a United States-backed peace plan, [[Israelis|Israeli citizens]] will be allowed to visit the [[Arab states of the Persian Gulf|Gulf States]] for "business and political purposes", starting next year. [https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20191126-israelis-will-be-able-to-visit-gulf-states-next-year-says-former-minister/ (Middle East Monitor)] 
*[[China–United States trade war]]
**[[Discount retailer]] [[Dollar Tree]] reports that it will miss its analysts' profit expectations for this quarter, blaming the shortfall on the tariff costs imposed by the [[Federal government of the United States|United States government]] on products it imports from [[China]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-dollar-tree-results/dollar-tree-forecast-misses-as-tariffs-bite-shares-slump-17-idUSKBN1Y01I1?il=0 (Reuters)] 

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2019 Albania earthquake]]
**A 6.4 magnitude earthquake hits coastal [[Albania]], bringing down many buildings and leaving people trapped under rubble. The [[Ministry of Defense (Albania)|Defense Ministry]] confirms 30 people killed and 650 others injured, mostly in [[Durrës County]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-50562552 (BBC News)]
**[[Pope Francis]] prays for victims of the earthquake in [[Albania]] and sends “heartfelt condolences” to [[Albanian President]] [[Ilir Meta]]. The quake's epicenter is less than 20 miles from [[Tirana]], the country’s capital city, which has a population of 900,000. Additional earthquakes occurred in southern [[Bosnia]] and the [[Greek island]] of [[Crete]]. [https://www.catholicnewsagency.com/news/pope-francis-prays-for-victims-of-deadly-earthquake-in-albania-39805 (CNA)]

;Health and environment
*[[2019 Samoa measles outbreak]]
**The death toll from the [[measles]] outbreak in [[Samoa]] has reached 32 with over 2,400 cases recorded. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2019-11-26/samoa-measles-emergency-claims-32-lives-as-death-toll-rises/11738138 (ABC Australia)]

;Law and crime
*[[Censorship in Vietnam]]
**A court in [[Vietnam]] sentences a [[Facebook]] user to six years in prison for anti-state posts on the social media. It is the latest case seen as a crackdown on [[Government of Vietnam|government]] [[dissident]]s. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-vietnam-security-trials/vietnam-jails-another-facebook-user-as-dissent-crackdown-intensifies-idUSKBN1Y014L (Reuters)]
*[[2019 Chilean protests]]
**[[Human Rights Watch]] releases a report about "serious" [[human rights]] violations committed by [[Carabineros de Chile|Carabineros]], confirming the findings of [[Amnesty International]] published last week. [https://www.france24.com/en/20191126-serious-rights-violations-during-chile-protests-human-rights-watch (France 24)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Politics of Mauritius]]
**Acting [[President of Mauritius|President]] [[Barlen Vyapoory]] resigns from office. Eddy Balancy, the Chief Justice of the [[Supreme Court of Mauritius]], becomes the country's new acting president. [https://www.lexpress.mu/article/366014/qui-sera-prochain-ou-prochaine-presidente-republique-selon-vous (''L'Express'')]
*[[2019 Australian Parliament infiltration plot]], [[Chinese intelligence activity abroad]]
**[[Australian Security Intelligence Organisation|ASIO]] is investigating an alleged plot by the [[Communist Party of China]] to install an agent into the [[Parliament of Australia]]. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2019-11-26/pressure-is-on-to-reign-in-chinese-spying-in-australia/11736530 (ABC Australia)]

;Science and technology
*[[2019 in spaceflight]]
**[[Egypt]]'s first ever [[communications satellite]] TIBA 1 is launched by [[Arianespace]] on an [[Ariane 5]] [[Ariane (rocket family)|rocket]] from the [[Guiana Space Centre]]. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/us-egypt-space-satellite/egypt-launches-first-communication-satellite-cabinet-idUKKBN1Y02LT (Reuters)]
